role_and_message.evidence: The M comparison retains four annotation settings for object detection: WSOD, SSOD, SAOD and SIOD.

panel_and_object_coverage.evidence: All eight original scene photographs and their original image labels/bounding boxes remain within four complete panels.

labels_math_and_numbers.evidence: Every original object label, acronym and panel letter remains; added acronym expansions follow introduction.

connections_and_direction.evidence: Original two-image grouping and labeled/unlabeled distinction are preserved; no extra annotations or boxes are added.

visual_encodings.evidence: Original category colors, box coordinates and image-level text remain exactly as source; no new confidence or ground-truth status is invented.

examples_and_data.evidence: Four complete original panels independently match exact2x nearest source pixels, including all annotation differences.

unsupported_additions.evidence: Image-level supervision, labeled/unlabeled-image mixture, partial instance annotation and one instance per category per image are explicitly described in pp1–2.

complete_visible_content.evidence: All original labels and scenes remain complete; new explanatory text is outside scientific images.

remaining_limitations: Original examples, content and source resolution remain; new text is limited to original caption/body claims. Layout quality is assessed separately.
